marco: Quick sync: prepping joint pilot announcement with GateWayCo and LangLink for marketplace + SI onboarding. Need runbook, embargo window, and a short tech blurb for docs. Who can own the integration verification checklist?

anna: I'll own the checklist. Quick Q: do we require LlamaIndex connector cert or just LangChain adapter?

simon: For pilot, we need both validated. LlamaIndex connector must pass smoke tests on our dedicated infra. LangChain runner needs example notebooks.

maya: Also need to confirm marketplace listing asset sizes (1-pager + 2 min demo). Sam from hw partnerships to confirm HW partner branding guidelines.

sam: @maya sending guidelines now. Note that SIs will require on-prem compatibility notes for Private deployments.

dev-bot: New checklist created: /checklists/isv-integration-1701010101.md

anna: I'll add smoke test commands: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orch` and a LangChain snippet.

liam: For announcement, propose embargo 2024-06-15, press blast + joint blog. Need quotes from GateWayCo and SI lead.

simon: Ops note: verify dedicated GPU throughput on A100/MI250 with gating tests. I'll run perf job and share results.

anna: timeline: checklist + smoke tests by Tue, demo asset by Thu, legal signoff EOW. Is that feasible?

sam: feasible, but HW partner needs 3 days for legal review.

maya: adjust timeline: legal signoff next Tue then announcement the following week.

liam: I'll schedule a recording slot for the demo on Fri 2pm PT.

anna: tagging tasks: @simon perf, @sam hw brand, @liam comms, @maya product approvals. I'll circulate runbook draft after perf results.

simon: ack. I'll post perf logs to /shared/interop/perf-1701010101.log

maya: small ask: include a block explaining fallback routing policy between gateway and hosted model for customers worried about cost/latency.

anna: good call — will add sample policy YAML snippet.

liam: can we get one-liner quotes? need by Mon.

sam: I'll nudge partner legal.

marco: Thanks everyone. If blockers arise ping me. :rocket:
